name: Calibrate one official PROMOTE rejection through the raw call-site observer after a private cost-one appointment

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive()

steps.code: local row=assert(GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas['LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO']); local d=assert(GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]); assert(d.Index==4 and row.EvolutionCost==1); assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_RECEIPT')==nil); local n=0; for _,id in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajorIDs()) do for persona in GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas() do local g=assert(GameInfo.Governors[persona.GovernorType]); assert(Players[id]:GetGovernors():CanEverAppointGovernor(g.Hash)==false); n=n+1 end end; assert(n==484); return 'unjoined 484 native pairs closed; Ashina runtime Index 4'

UI.RequestPlayerOperation(0,PlayerOperations.EXECUTE_SCRIPT,{OnStart='JAC_JoinedAdmissionInitialize',ManualAppoint=1}); return 'request synchronized 484 false derived permissions and private manual appointment ownership'

condition.code: local r=Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_RECEIPT'); return r and r.phase=='CLOSED' and r.pairs==484 and Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_ACTIVE')==1 and Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_MANUAL_APPOINT')==1 and Players[0]:GetProperty(853304)==false and Players[1]:GetProperty(853304)==false

steps.code: local count=0; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if not p:IsHuman() then local g=p:GetGovernors(); if g:GetGovernorPoints()-g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()<1 then local culture=p:GetCulture(); local added=false; for row in GameInfo.JAC_PersonaTitleCivics() do local c=GameInfo.Civics[row.CivicType]; if not culture:HasCivic(c.Index) then culture:SetCulturalProgress(c.Index,culture:GetCultureCost(c.Index)); added=true; break end end; assert(added,'AI title civic unavailable') end; assert(g:GetGovernorPoints()-g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()>=1 and g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()==0); count=count+1 end end; assert(count==21); return '21 AI have real civic titles and zero spent'

local count=0; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if not p:IsHuman() then local g=p:GetGovernors(); assert(g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()==0,'AI spent before join'); for row in GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas() do local d=assert(GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]); assert(g:CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash)==false and not g:HasGovernor(d.Hash),'unjoined AI appointment') end; count=count+1 end end; assert(count==21); return 'real AI turn kept all unjoined Governors and Spent closed'

local d=assert(GameInfo.Governors[GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas['LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'].GovernorType]); assert(d.Index==4); assert(Players[0]:GetGovernors():CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash)==false and Players[1]:GetGovernors():CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash)==false); assert(Players[0]:GetProperty(853304)==false); return 'native owner bound while every Ashina permission remains false'
UI.RequestPlayerOperation(0,PlayerOperations.EXECUTE_SCRIPT,{OnStart='JAC_JoinedAdmissionPrepare'}); return 'request real Join, unique Great Person, official title and full reservation'

condition.code: local r=Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_RECEIPT'); local d=GameInfo.Governors[GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas['LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'].GovernorType]; return r and r.phase=='EVOLVING' and r.owner==0 and r.source==2 and r.personCount==1 and r.total-r.spent>=1 and Players[0]:GetProperty(853304)==true and Players[0]:GetGovernors():CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash)==true

steps.code: local leader='LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'; local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_RECEIPT'),'native preappoint receipt missing'); local owner=Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..leader..'_OWNER'); local stage=Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..leader..'_STATE'); assert(owner==0 and stage=='EVOLVING','native preappoint owner='..tostring(owner)..' state='..tostring(stage)..' receiptOwner='..tostring(r.owner)..' receiptPhase='..tostring(r.phase)); local ids=PlayerManager.GetAliveMajorIDs(); assert(type(ids)=='table','native preappoint alive IDs type='..type(ids)); assert(#ids==22,'native preappoint alive count='..tostring(#ids)); local count=0; for _,id in ipairs(ids) do local g=Players[id]:GetGovernors(); for row in GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas() do local d=assert(GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType],'native preappoint Governor definition missing '..row.GovernorType); local expected=id==0 and row.LeaderType==leader; local qualified=g:CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash); assert(qualified==expected,'wrong native qualification '..id..'/'..row.LeaderType..' actual='..tostring(qualified)..' expected='..tostring(expected)); count=count+1 end end; assert(count==484,'native preappoint native pair count='..tostring(count)); local d=GameInfo.Governors[GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[leader].GovernorType]; local g=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); local can=g:CanAppointGovernor(d.Hash); local has=g:HasGovernor(d.Hash); local spent=g:GetGovernorPointsSpent(); assert(can and not has and spent==r.spent,'native preappoint canAppoint='..tostring(can)..' hasGovernor='..tostring(has)..' spent='..tostring(spent)..' receiptSpent='..tostring(r.spent)); return 'only joined owner Ashina admitted across all 484 native pairs'

local d=assert(GameInfo.Governors[GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas['LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'].GovernorType]); UI.RequestPlayerOperation(0,PlayerOperations.APPOINT_GOVERNOR,{[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GOVERNOR_TYPE]=d.Index}); return 'one official APPOINT requested for joined cost-one Ashina'

condition.code: local r=Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_RECEIPT'); local row=GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas['LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO']; local d=GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]; local g=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); return r and g:HasGovernor(d.Hash) and g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()==r.spent+1

steps.code: local l='LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'; local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_RECEIPT')); local row=GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[l]; local d=GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]; local g=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); local physical=assert(g:GetGovernor(d.Hash)); assert(physical:HasPromotion(GameInfo.GovernorPromotions[row.BasePromotionType].Hash) and g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()==r.spent+1); assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..l..'_STATE')=='EVOLVING'); return 'official native Governor, base and one Spent confirmed'

local l='LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'; local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_RECEIPT')); local row=GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[l]; local d=GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]; local p=Players[0]; local g=p:GetGovernors(); assert(g:HasGovernor(d.Hash) and g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()==r.spent+1 and g:GetGovernor(d.Hash):HasPromotion(GameInfo.GovernorPromotions[row.BasePromotionType].Hash)); local people=0; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do local gp=u:GetGreatPerson(); local id=gp and gp:GetIndividual(); local person=id~=nil and id~=-1 and GameInfo.GreatPersonIndividuals[id]; if person and person.GreatPersonIndividualType==row.PersonType then people=people+1 end end; assert(people==0 and Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..l..'_UNIT')==nil); local count=0; for _,id in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajorIDs()) do for person in GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas() do local def=GameInfo.Governors[person.GovernorType]; assert(Players[id]:GetGovernors():CanEverAppointGovernor(def.Hash)==(id==0 and person.LeaderType==l)); count=count+1 end end; assert(count==484); return 'finalized native Governor and Spent one; Great Person gone; other 483 closed'

local p=Players[0]; assert(Game.GetLocalPlayer()==0 and p:IsHuman() and p:IsTurnActive()); local g=p:GetGovernors(); local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_RECEIPT')); assert(g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()==r.spent+1); if g:GetGovernorPoints()-g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()<1 then local culture=p:GetCulture(); local added=false; for row in GameInfo.JAC_PersonaTitleCivics() do local c=GameInfo.Civics[row.CivicType]; if not culture:HasCivic(c.Index) then culture:SetCulturalProgress(c.Index,culture:GetCultureCost(c.Index)); added=true; break end end; assert(added,'no official title civic remains') end; return 'one official spare title prepared for native promotion rejection'

local row=assert(GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas['LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO']); local d=assert(GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]); local promotion=assert(GameInfo.GovernorPromotions[row.BasePromotionType]); local g=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); local unit=assert(g:GetGovernor(d.Hash)); assert(Game.GetLocalPlayer()==0 and Players[0]:IsTurnActive() and unit:HasPromotion(promotion.Hash) and not g:CanEarnPromotion(d.Hash,promotion.Hash)); ExposedMembers.JAC_PromotionCallCalibration={spent=g:GetGovernorPointsSpent(),total=g:GetGovernorPoints(),governorIndex=d.Index,promotionIndex=promotion.Index}; UI.RequestPlayerOperation(0,PlayerOperations.PROMOTE_GOVERNOR,{[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GOVERNOR_TYPE]=d.Index,[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GOVERNOR_PROMOTION_TYPE]=promotion.Index}); return 'one formal PROMOTE request for already-owned base; raw call entry only'

local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_RECEIPT')); local g=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); assert(g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()==r.spent+1 and g:GetGovernorPoints()>=g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()+1,'native core account changed after owned-base request'); return 'Core official Spent remains one appointment with a spare title'

local before=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_PromotionCallCalibration); local row=GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas['LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO']; local g=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); local unit=assert(g:GetGovernor(GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType].Hash)); assert(g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()==before.spent and g:GetGovernorPoints()==before.total and unit:HasPromotion(GameInfo.GovernorPromotions[row.BasePromotionType].Hash),'native title account or base changed'); return 'owned-base request rejected without another title payment'
